Intent boundary & complementary capture

Inspect held-out calibration

Access and selection

Monitors receive the recorded view. Probes receive a deterministic window of at most 3,072 transcript tokens. Gates read recorded tool calls and diffs. Inner family folds select depth, pooling and regularization before each outer family is scored. Outer false alarms are measured directly.

Post-hoc probes use Qwen2.5-Coder-0.5B (bf16) and 3B (4-bit). The reproduction command verifies saved decisions and calibration arithmetic.
